description: Report a problem with an order. not_received is allowed while the order is marked shipped. Other reasons require a delivered order waiting for confirmation. This records the issue, pauses the seller payout, and notifies ForthClear. Requires sign-in with buyer access. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

reason.description: Dispute reason. not_received is allowed while the order is shipped. The other reasons require delivered_pending_confirmation.
